entities.name: TFF3
observations: Also called intestinal trefoil factor (ITF). In HEK293 and LS174T cells, hTFF3 dose-dependently increased TFF3 promoter luciferase activity; mutation of a promoter STAT3 motif impaired self-induction (PMID:27453253).
A separate human promoter-reporter study found ITF-stimulated reporter activity reduced by AG490 (P<0.05), supporting but not proving JAK-pathway involvement (PMID:25432365).

entities.name: STAT3
observations: STAT3 occupied the TFF3 promoter by ChIP; promoter motif mutation and STAT3 overexpression/knockdown supported STAT3-dependent TFF3 self-induction (PMID:27453253).

entities.name: JAK-STAT3 signaling
observations: Evidence for pathway contribution includes reduced ITF promoter-reporter activity after AG490 treatment; direct biochemical JAK-mediated STAT3 activation was not established in retrieved evidence (PMID:25432365).

entities.name: PMID:27453253
observations: Scientific Reports (2016): hTFF3 increased TFF3 promoter reporter activity dose-dependently; a STAT3 motif, STAT3 promoter occupancy, and STAT3 gain/loss experiments supported promoter regulation.

entities.name: PMID:25432365
observations: Journal of Central South University Medical Sciences (2014): ITF-stimulated human ITF promoter luciferase activity; AG490 significantly reduced reporter output (P<0.05); available abstract details are limited.

entities.name: TFF3 promoter self-induction
observations: Direct luciferase assays support TFF3/ITF peptide increasing its own promoter transcriptional activity; STAT3 is implicated by motif mutation, ChIP, and gain/loss experiments. JAK dependence is suggestive, not fully demonstrated.
